table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= item.name,  
			itemalias=item.customicode,
			packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
			accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
			aliasname = dbo.accounts.aliasname, 
			godown=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=srdetail.gcode),
			address = dbo.customer.address1,
			address2=dbo.customer.address2,
			custphone=customer.phone,
			saleperson=(select name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=srledger.smancode),
			custcity=dbo.customer.city,
			areaname=(select name from area where area.areacode=customer.areacode),
			salesman = dbo.users.username, 
			srinvcode = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
			saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode,   
         date = dbo.srledger.date,   
         invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.srledger.salestax,   
         dbo.srledger.custcode, 
         gcode = srdetail.gcode,   
         icode = srdetail.icode,   
         batch = srdetail.batch,   
         expiry = srdetail.expiry,   
			looseqty = srdetail.looseqty,
			packqty  = srdetail.packqty,
			bonusqty = srdetail.bonusqty,
			packunits= srdetail.packunits,
	 		saleprice= srdetail.srprice,
	 		discperc = srdetail.discperc,
         salestax = srdetail.salestax ,
			unitsalestax=srdetail.unitsalestax,
			itemgstperc=srdetail.gstperc,
			invgstperc=srledger.invgstperc1,
			remarks=srledger.remarks,
			srledger.headerno,
			srledger.headerinvNo,
			reprintingcounter=srledger.reprintingcounter

    FROM srledger, 
			srdetail, 
			accounts, 
			customer,
			users, 
			item  
 
   WHERE ( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = :ar_SRInvCode ) AND
			( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode) AND
			( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.srledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
			( dbo.srdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  discperc ) ,2) -  flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )

objects.name: c_totalsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round( (sum (c_amount for all) * 0.01 * discperc) * ( 1 -  flatdisc ) * (invgstperc  *  0.01) ,2)  + Round(sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) , 2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(sum( c_amount ) * (1 -   invdiscperc   * .01) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  salestax , 0)  + Round(Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  discperc ) ,2) -  flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )  + sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   * (bonusqty + looseqty) ) , 2)
